slice: AVI-MOVI-003 movi scan collection bounded exact proof slice (not the whole Issue and not all of AVI-MOVI-003)

environment.memory_measurement: /usr/bin/time -v wrapping each cargo kani invocation; not per-solver cgroup isolation

input_domain.entry_count: fixed N=3 symbolic direct child entries. N=3 is the minimum that covers packet-ignore-packet compaction order, packet after reject, non-leading reject precedence, and multiple packet ordering in one finite composition
input_domain.chunk_id_per_entry: full [u8;4] chunk id for each entry; all 2^32 bit patterns independently. LIST/non-LIST, digit/non-digit prefixes, known/unknown/opaque kind suffixes, and non-ASCII bytes are not sampled or narrowed
input_domain.list_type_view_per_entry: full Option<[u8;4]> for each entry; None means fewer than 4 body bytes are available for a direct child LIST, and Some(bytes) exactly represents the first 4 body bytes when the body length is at least 4. All 2^32 byte patterns are symbolic independently
input_domain.production_reparameterization: production observes only the presence/absence of the first four bytes of a LIST body for this decision; body tail bytes, padding, chunk size, offsets, and packet body contents are outside the scan-collection-core input rather than narrowed symbolic inputs
input_domain.non_list_total_extension: for non-LIST ids the production loop passes None or the input is unobserved; the proof keeps the symbolic Option domain and verifies that the decision does not depend on it
input_domain.explicit_bound: fixed N=3 is bounded model scope, not a kani::assume input narrowing. N+1 or longer entry sequences, arbitrary-length sequences, and unbounded iteration termination remain unproven
input_domain.excluded_inputs: none within the fixed three-entry scan collection input domain. Outer RIFF/LIST structure, iterator errors, body slices, stream declarations, packet payload interpretation, and timing inputs are outside this sub-boundary

assume_classification: No kani::assume and no input narrowing. Constructing Option<[u8;4]> symbolically is exact reparameterization of the observed body-prefix interface. The fixed entry count is explicit bounded model scope. No MP4-SCAN-003-style valid_steps/model-scale assume is needed because the sequence length is fixed. The model unrolls three entries and does not reduce unwind depth to pass.

coverage.collection_order: collected packet tags equal the tags of packet-decision entries before the first reject, in input order
coverage.first_reject_stop: the earliest reject determines the stop kind and entries after it contribute neither to collection nor to the result
coverage.reject_precedence: when multiple rejects exist, the earliest index wins; short-list and rec-list reject kinds are not reordered
coverage.ignore_non_collection: ignore entries add no packet and do not disturb packet order
coverage.no_reject_sequence: when no reject exists, every packet entry is collected in order
coverage.exact_complement: production per-entry decisions are checked against an independent raw-input oracle for exactly one of packet/ignore/short-list reject/rec-list reject per entry
coverage.tag_preservation: collected tags preserve stream number and kind byte order through the production decision and scan-step mapping
coverage.arithmetic_safety: the fixed finite model and helpers are checked for overflow/underflow/panic freedom over the full symbolic input domain
coverage.production_connection: the production movi loop calls avi_movi_scan_step(avi_movi_entry_decision(...)); the proof model calls the same production functions for each symbolic entry. MediaError construction, body slices, iterator error precedence, and Vec push remain shell responsibilities
coverage.oracle_independence: the expected scan oracle classifies raw ids/list-type views directly and does not call avi_movi_entry_decision or avi_movi_scan_step, so mutations in either production mapping are detectable by the scan proof itself

initial_lane_before_mutation.note: initial cold-cache pass retained as auxiliary evidence; final canonical lane is kani/ after mutation revert

mutation.description: temporary production mutation changed the Packet arm in avi_movi_scan_step from Collect(tag) to Skip
mutation.expected_detection: avi-movi-scan proof must fail; generic boundary-only/tag-only/entry-decision-only failures or diagnostic-payload-only mutations are not accepted as scan collection oracle evidence
mutation.revert: mutation reverted exactly; final avi-movi-scan lane, mise run test al-media, and mise run test-formal passed after revert

The new proof is narrower: fixed three-entry scan collection composition only. The lower rerun cost is not evidence of equivalent assurance.
